Dog owners urged to protect pets from parvovirus in P.E.I.

An expert has advised dog owners in Prince Edward Island (P.E.I.) to take precautions to safeguard their pets following the detection of parvovirus. Separately, fatal dog attacks in Hong Kong have raised safety concerns, prompting advice on how individuals can protect themselves.
